description: The router's one call: the coaches to call, or Holos's own short reply.

agents.description: Every coach the request needs and only those: physical (exercise, training, movement, sport, pain during exercise), nutrition (food, meals, diet, drinks, supplements), mental (stress, mood, anxiety, sleep, motivation, focus, emotions). Empty unless kind is coaching.
agents.title: Agents

kind.description: coaching: the user wants advice, a plan, an answer or to log something about exercise, food or mental wellbeing. greeting: a hello, thanks or goodbye. meta: a question about Holos itself. off_topic: anything outside exercise, food and mental wellbeing. unclear: you can't tell what they want. other_language: the message is not in English, Hindi or Hinglish.
kind.title: Kind

reply.description: Your own short reply, at most 400 characters. Null when kind is coaching. At most 400 characters.
reply.title: Reply
